# Clayfolk

> 30 free clay-style avatars for mockups and UIs. PNG, WebP and looping MP4. Install: npm i clayfolk

## How to use
- Pick an avatar by mood, role, age, presentation or tags from the list below.
- Image URL (WebP, 512px): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/clayfolk@0.1.0/assets/webp/<id>.webp
- Transparent background (cutout): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/clayfolk@0.1.0/assets/webp-cutout/<id>.webp, or imageUrl(id, { variant: "cutout" })
- Looping video URL (MP4, 720px): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/clayfolk@0.1.0/assets/mp4/<id>.mp4
- PNGs (colored and transparent) are not in the package; they are free to download from https://clayfolk.dev
- In code: import { avatars, imageUrl, videoUrl } from "clayfolk"
- Always include alt text from the "alt" field.
- License: code MIT, assets see ASSETS-LICENSE.md. Free for commercial use; do not resell the set.
